<div style="text-align:center;font-size:1,7em;font-weight:bold;">[[Image:Portal.gif|<nowiki></nowiki>]] Welcome to the Community Portal
</div>

You can help build '''''A Wheel of Time Wiki''''' into a better wiki by [[Wikipedia:Wikipedia:How to edit a  page|editing]] and [[Wikipedia:Help:Starting a new page|creating]] new [[Wikipedia:Wikipedia:What is an article|articles]]. If you [[Special:Userlogin|create an account]], you can track your changes [[Wikipedia:Wikipedia:Why create an account?|and more]]. If you don't know where to start, try visiting the [[Special:Wantedpages|list of most requested pages]] (by links) and start typing! Additional areas of particular need can be found at [[:Category:Stubs]] and [[:Category:Cleanup]].

==About us==
<p style="margin: 0.5em 0 0; text-align: center; 
font-size: 125%; line-height: 1.3">
Welcome to '''''A Wheel of Time Wiki''''', the free, unofficial repository of ''[[The Wheel of Time]]'' material that anyone can edit.</p>
<p style="margin:0 0 0;text-align:center;font-size:94%">
In this New Tongue version, started on October 17th, 2005, we are currently working on [[Special:Allpages|{{NUMBEROFARTICLES}}]] articles.</p>

<br>

We aim to be the ''definitive'' fan-created source of plot summaries, character information, FAQs, glossary of terms, theories, and even fan information such as conventions, parodies, etc.

At this stage, we have over 6,000 pages but our goal is not complete, and '''you can help'''!  So if you've read the books, please ''feel free'' to jump in and start contributing. You should also join our Discord where lively discussion about the books and the wiki happens.

Spread the word of Robert Jordan's bestselling series by buying the first book, [[The Eye of the World]] for a friend or family member that hasn't read the series.

''The Wheel of Time is © Copyright [[Robert Jordan]].''<br>
''The phrases The Wheel of Time™ and The Dragon Reborn™ are trademarks of Robert Jordan.''
